text.text_excerpt: The day I walked into Rouses #35 Gentilly/Franklin Avenue store was not planned. I'm usually at the Veterans store in Metairie,but, I was in Gentilly and I decided I would go there. I read the reviews, and was a little worried about what I was to expect. I looked around and the store was immaculate. I had my "to get" list, and I started up the aisles for my items to purchase. The shelves were stocked, the staff was extremely helpful and the perishables were current, also the non-perishables. I couldn't find one item so, I stopped to ask a young man, (who happened to have beautiful wavy hair and a "boo ti ful" "nat ur rul" olive complexion), I asked, where was the uh, Asian sauces?. He was...

Everyone at this store is always so nice and helpful. I am thanked for shopping there on every visit, sometimes a few times. The store is always clean and easy to get around. Nice big aisles! I'll shop here just for the friendly staff! Such a nice change in today's world where people barely speak to each other.

Since Katrina, Rouses has made a 180 in terms of food selection, customer service, wine collection & overall appearance. I am ever so pleased with my neighborhood Rouses. While maybe not as large as some others, this Rouses is plentiful in its selection, prices are a little elevated, but still reasonable. You have many opportunities to select hard to find/exotic items; almost to the point of gourmet. It's to the point that it's almost that some departments are kinda "boutique-like" with the cute quirky items you find. I'm also a fan of the "local's" department, where you can find Saints, LSU & sometimes Tulane paraphernalia, yessssssss!!!!! Lots of local charm which gives you a "down-home...
